notes.title: Version 1.09.113 Released!
notes.content:
Brazil Fencing Club has been updated with the following changes:

[list]
[*]Added controller haptics feedback for blade contact and menu selections.
[*]Added two new more complex practice opponents: one left-handed and one right-handed. 
[*]Your opponent will now match your position on the width of the fencing piste.
[*]The default pistol grip foil now has a more detailed blade with wire groove, tip tape, and proper tip.
[/list]

[h3]New Weapons:[/h3]
Added several new weapon models that can be earned by winning competition bouts:

[list]
[*]A French grip foil
[*]An Italian grip foil
[*]A French grip figure-eight foil
[*]A saber (the modern fencing kind)
[*]A French grip épée
[*]A pistol grip épée
[/list]

Note: Despite the addition of épées and a saber, this remains a foil fencing game.

[h3]Weapon Selection:[/h3]
Once earned, your weapons can be changed by selecting them from the wooden weapon stands on the back wall while the game is displaying the selection menu at the end of the opponent's side of the strip.

[h3]Footwork Speed Adjustment:[/h3]
The controller footwork speed has been adjusted to match your real footwork speed. You will now need to advance and retreat on the fencing piste while the game times you.

[h3]Weapon/VR Controller Offset Adjustment:[/h3]
You can now adjust your weapon/VR controller offset for multiple purposes:

[list]
[*]Adjust weapon/hand placement and rotation to your liking.
[*]Use a real fencing grip attachment with your controller. (Note: We do not sell these attachments; you will need to build one yourself.)
[*]Pommel a French grip like an épéeist.
[/list]

[h3]New Settings:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Enable blade glow for priority (right-of-way) when fencing.
[*]Lock out controller rotating/turning while fencing for better control.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the bend of the blade started behind the guard when canting your blade.
[*]Warmup lesson not working due to player's onguard position too high or too low.
Opponent's overreaching with disengage.
[/list]

More updates coming soon.

notes.title: Verion 1.06 Released
notes.content:
Dear Fencers,

We have released version 1.06 of The Brazil Fencing Club with the following updates:

[list]
[*]More realistic movement speed while fencing. Edit the CONFIG.DAT file to “MOVESPEED=3.5” if you preferred the older faster speed.  (controller movement only)

[*]Added a short lived reduction of speed when changing directions (controller movement only).

[*]Added a coach led private warm-up lesson I had created for myself.

[*]Added a coach led private advance lunge lesson I had created for myself.

[*]The simple practice left and right hand fencers will now have a delay in their direction changes. So when the opponents advances without priority the player will have an instant to hit before the opponent can retreat.

[*]Competition fencer, Anna Troy, will now have another attack added to her game.

[*]Competition fencer, Alexandra Campion, will now remark “Sitting Duck” to the player if the player doesn't respond to her check.

[*]Competition fencer, Walter Golden, will now require the player to have tighter blade movements to weave through his wall of defensive parries.

[*]Added an option to turn off controller movement to force player to use real footwork.  This would require a very large play space and for the player to have knowledge of actual real fencing footwork.

[*]Added an optional reminder for the player to stay down in their on guard if the player is actually trying to learn to use a real on guard fencing stance.

[*]Access to the developer menu in case the player wishes to try to script their own custom fencers or fencing lessons.
[/list]

The goal with this game is to create as much of a realistic fencing experience in VR as possible.  I hope these updates improve your VR fencing experience and there will be plenty of more updates in the future.  

CounterParry
